narrow: chitin-based cuticle sclerotization by protein cross-linking and cuticle tanning

definition: The process of hardening of a chitin-based cuticle by protein cross-linking, and the incorporation of phenolic precursors. This mechanism of cuticle hardening occurs in insects and is usually accompanied by darkening of the cuticle.
label: chitin-based cuticle sclerotization by protein cross-linking
